scholarships.name: Prime Minister'S Scholarship Scheme For Wards Of States/UTs Police Personnel Martyred During Terror/Naxal Attacks (Merit Based Scheme)
scholarships.description: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for wards of State/UT Police personnel who were martyred during terror or naxal attacks, administered by the Welfare and Rehabilitation Board (WARB), Ministry of Home Affairs.

eligibility.income_limit_description: No income ceiling specified in official guidelines.
eligibility.category_description: Open to all categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS).
eligibility.course_description: First professional degree courses recognized by respective regulatory councils (AICTE, NMC, DCI, PCI). Non-professional degrees like BA, B.Sc, B.Com not eligible.
eligibility.education_level_description: Professional Undergraduate Degree or approved professional Master's degree (MCA/MBA).
eligibility.percentage_description: Minimum 60% marks in 10+2 / Diploma / Graduation as qualifying examination.
eligibility.cgpa_requirement: Equivalent to 60% as per university conversion formula.
eligibility.state_domicile_description: All India (All States and Union Territories).
eligibility.disability_description: Not specified in source as mandatory requirement.
eligibility.admission_type: Regular full-time admission in recognized university/institute.
institution_requirements: Institution must be recognized by respective regulatory body (AICTE/UGC/NMC/DCI).
Distance education / correspondence degrees are not eligible.
family_conditions: Exclusively for dependent wards and widows of State/UT Police personnel martyred during terror/naxal attacks.
eligibility.number_of_beneficiaries_limit: 500 fresh scholarships annually (250 for boys, 250 for girls).
special_category_requirements: Ward of Police / CAPF Personnel Martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks
other_conditions: Applicable for single degree course only. Student cannot claim scholarship for subsequent second degree.

selection.selection_criteria: Merit list prepared based on normalized marks obtained in 10+2 / diploma / graduation.
selection.merit_criteria: Percentage scored in Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ).
selection.ranking_method: In case of tie in percentage, elder applicant by date of birth is ranked higher.
selection.selection_priority: Order of Priority: Priority I (Wards of personnel killed in action), followed by subsequent priorities as specified in WARB guidelines.
selection.state_wise_allocation: Quota allocated state-wise as per ministerial schedule.
selection.renewal_conditions: Must secure minimum 50% marks in each academic year to continue scholarship.

benefits.amount_per_interval: ₹3,000 per month for girls (₹36,000/yr) and ₹2,500 per month for boys (₹30,000/yr)
benefits.fee_reimbursement: Not separate; paid as consolidated stipend.

components.title: Girls Monthly Stipend
components.description: ₹3,000 per month paid annually via DBT

components.title: Boys Monthly Stipend
components.description: ₹2,500 per month paid annually via DBT

benefits.maximum_duration: Up to 5 years depending on prescribed course duration.
benefits.number_of_installments: 1 annual installment directly transferred to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
benefit_specific_conditions: Bank account must be in candidate's own name and mapped with Aadhaar in NPCI mapper.

application.application_period: Annual cycle on National Scholarship Portal.
application.application_mode: Online exclusively through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
application.renewal_requirements: Passing marksheet and bonafide certificate verified by Head of Institution.
application.verification_requirements: L1 verification by Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and L2 verification by State Nodal Officer (SNO / WARB).

required_documents: Martyr Certificate issued by State DGP / WARB / MHA
Bonafide Certificate from Head of Institution

exclusions: Distance/open learning degrees not permitted.
Students already in receipt of other Central Govt scholarships are restricted.
conditions_ineligible: Failure to secure 50% marks in annual examination terminates the award.
restrictions.simultaneous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any other scholarship from Central / State Government or PSU for the same course.
restrictions.fee_reimbursement_restrictions: Stipendiary scheme; no separate reimbursement of hostel or tuition fees.
restrictions.institution_restrictions: Foreign universities not covered.
restrictions.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Not eligible if candidate has already completed another professional degree with scholarship.
